description.value: Choices Market is a British Columbia-based specialty grocery chain known for prioritizing local producers, natural and organic products, and strong community engagement. The Abbotsford location, open since 2015, offers a full range of departments including Bakery, Deli, Bulk, Produce, and Wellness. It sits in a retail complex on Immel Street and would serve as a well-stocked resupply point for touring cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (2 spaces) at 37m; rack (4 spaces) at 74m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record and website content both confirm Choices Market is a real, operating specialty/natural-foods supermarket chain with an Abbotsford location (email abbotsford@choicesmarkets.com, postal code V2S 6S2 is Abbotsford). The website content is a store-locator and careers page with no amenity details specific to this location, so nearly all amenity fields remain null. Basic groceries is set true because the OSM tag is shop=supermarket and the website confirms a full-service grocery operation with departments including Bakery, Bulk, Deli, Grocery, Produce, etc.
concerns: OSM community field says 'Chilliwack' but the store address (V2S 6S2) and store email (abbotsford@choicesmarkets.com) clearly place this in Abbotsford — these are distinct cities roughly 30 km apart. The community field may be miscategorized.

Website fetched content is a generic store-locator/careers page and does not display the specific phone number or street address for the Abbotsford location, so phone and address contact confirmation cannot be made.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating supermarket confirmed by OSM and website; useful resupply stop for touring cyclists in the Abbotsford area.
